title: Orsen and the Mixtape
author: Vesper Montrose
blurb: Lena Brightwater, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
